turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I have been trying to place an order for half an hour now but the site is soooo slow, is there anything ai can do to speed this up?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, there are some things we can try

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Try visiting another website and then coming back to this one and see if it's faster

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No it seems to be the same

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ok, try logging out of the site and then logging back in and see if that helps

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That helped a for a second but it is still really slow

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When you tried another website was that also slow or is only this site slow?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No the other site loaded quickly and was fine

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: See if the site is faster with all other tabs and programs closed

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ok

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I actually logged out and back in and it is better

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's great

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Maybe there were many people on at one time?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's possible

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No thank you, have a great day

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You too

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll end this chat now

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: bye
